description: React component for the main page of a personal notes manager app, handling authentication, fetching, creating, saving, and deleting notes.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from API and updates state; sets first note as selected if none selected.

methods.name: handleCreateNote
methods.description: Creates a new note via API and refreshes notes list.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Saves changes to the current note via API and refreshes notes list.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note via API, clears selection, and refreshes notes list.
